comments.body:
Thanks for this focused fix. We have reproduced the false-success behavior on official AstrBot v4.29.4 and added sanitized production evidence to #10839: https://github.com/AstrBotDevs/AstrBot/issues/10839#issuecomment-6878747512

On 2026-11-14 after a service restart, six send_message_to_user calls to the same QQ group each produced "No cached msg_id ... skip send_by_session", followed by a successful "Message sent" tool result. The scheduled job was recorded as completed with no last_error.

The explicit exception in this PR would make that skipped-send path visible through the tool's existing error handler. Maintainers, could you please review it? Accurate failure reporting would help us detect missed scheduled notifications.

We understand that restoring delivery routes across restarts is a separate part of the fix, addressed by #10152. Our independent testing of these PRs is still pending.
